headline: Oando Announces Final Terms of N203.8 Billion Rights Issue
summary: Nigerian energy company Oando announced final terms for a rights issue offering roughly 4.1 billion ordinary shares at N50 per share on a one-for-two basis.
why: Rights issues allow existing shareholders to purchase additional shares at a discount, raising capital for corporate balance sheets.

impacts.name: Oando PLC
impacts.why: A major rights issue expands the equity capital base while potentially diluting existing shareholdings.
